replies.author: @Globallife.documentary
replies.text: In wealthy nations, extreme poverty often isolates individuals completely on the street, leaving them entirely disconnected from family and society. In places like Manila, the physical living conditions are far harsher, but the human safety net is remarkably intact: neighbors share whatever little rice they have, and multigenerational families stick together through thick and thin. Poverty has many faces, and both forms carry their own heartbreak. Appreciate you sharing this!
